caption:
At Sapporo's airport, skip the ticket queue ✈️🚆
Tap Suica and take the train.

🥇 JR Rapid Airport train

🚉 The station is right under
the Domestic Terminal.

💳 Tap Suica, ICOCA, PASMO or Kitaca
and board any non-reserved car.

🎫 No IC card? The ticket machines take cash.
The orange reserved-seat machines take cards.

🥈 Airport bus, if your hotel is a stop

🚌 It stops at Sapporo Station, Susukino
and several big Odori hotels.

💴 No booking. Pay when you get off:
cash, contactless card or PayPay.

❌ Suica doesn't work on the bus.

💡 Busy day?
Car 4 has reserved u-seats.
Book online for a seat and room for a big case.

💬 Comment CHITOSE for our free guide
to Sapporo's airport, including a Hakodate
seafood bowl inside the terminal.
